input_identity: Every visible file is recorded by relative path, byte size and SHA256 before baseline execution.

manifest_fields.authoritative_contract_path: optional non-truth contract/schema path for B0
manifest_fields.execution_fixture_id: optional preexisting runnable fixture authority for B4
manifest_fields.llm_visible_paths: exact UTF-8 blinded input files exposed to both LLM lanes
manifest_fields.projection_contract_path: optional non-truth projected schema path for B0
manifest_fields.required_identifiers: optional consequence-contract identifiers available to full-system input, never derived from truth
manifest_fields.truth_or_operator_paths: must be disjoint from every baseline-visible path
manifest_fields.unit_id: opaque heldout identifier assigned by stager

no_truncation_rule: No baseline may silently truncate an applicable input. Exceeding a frozen provider/engine limit yields INAPPLICABLE only if the applicability predicate prospectively says so; otherwise BASELINE_INVALID.
principle: All baselines and ablations receive only bytes or public role metadata available before truth unlock; no RISU verdict/certificate may be added to baseline input.
